governance.voting_structure: Une action une voix (common stock): "Each share of common stock is entitled to one vote." Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock sans droit de vote sur les propositions.

citations.quote: Our Board recommends a vote FOR each of the 10 nominees listed below. All of the nominees are currently serving as Directors.
Director Nominees Independent: 9 of 10 Average age: 65.3 Average tenure: 6.9 years

At our 2025 Annual Meeting of shareholders, we conducted our Say-on-Pay vote regarding our 2024 NEO compensation program. Approximately 69% of the shares voted on the Say-on-Pay vote were cast in favor of the vote.

On the Record Date, the Company had 117,886,887 shares of common stock outstanding. Each share of common stock is entitled to one vote. Shares of our Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock are not entitled to vote on any of the proposals to be considered at the Annual Meeting.
